★Request
SFX: Running footsteps

Jaja! Did ya see that?!
She's downright gorgeous! That smart little glance she gave...!

Yes! To show that girl just how far I've come...
I wanna get strong. I really wanna win...

Truth is... the person in that magazine I saw before moving here was her.
Ehehe, we were both so surprised when we found out after becoming friends!

Whoaaa...! Wh-What in the world...!
Is this a training plan meant just for me...?!

U-Um! Actually, there's a selection race coming up soon.
I figured if I prove my skills there, maybe somethin' will change.

Even just until then is fine! I want ya to train me
as hard as ya can! P-Please...!

Y-You think I've actually got skills worth showing?
Little ol' me...?
Yes! I'd love, love to hear all the details!

So until then... um,
would ya mind keeping an eye on my training?

Ja...! Well, uh, by "city girl",
I mean... how should I put it, they're just downright amazing!
Yes...!

"Go win in the URA someday!" Everyone in my village entrusted their dreams to me.
And before I knew it, I started getting really pumped up about it too.

The URA really does have cutting-edge training, doesn't it!
Back when I ran with my local club, we never did anything like this.

Right? A true "city girl" has got it all—beauty, talent, and heart,
every single bit of it! I wanna become just like that too...

Um, I wanted to thank ya for yesterday...!
Here, please take this! I hope it suits your taste...

Oguri-san and Inari-san became "stars" 'cause they were strong.
Same goes for City-san...! I wanna be just like that too...!

...Hehe... Is that so!
Thank ya kindly for giving it to me straight.

Sparkly, stylish, and super cool, but not just that!
Having strong willpower, real skill... Mmmrrgh, how do I say it?!
...Will following this plan get me closer to being a "city girl"?

Still... right now, people are only making a fuss 'cause it's amusing to watch a country bumpkin try hard...
I haven't shown any real skill at all.

It'd be faster just to show ya!
Let's go see a truly wonderful "city girl"! Right now!

I think that's what it really takes to become the "Star of Morioka."
I can't just be a passing fad—I have to be an Umamusume folks truly want to root for.
...! Trainer...

Her eyes were deadly serious... She clearly wanted my unvarnished opinion.
I wanted to respond to her feelings with absolute sincerity.
Trainer, you're a lot like the folks back home.

Heh! Aw, shucks! I don't really have any entertaining stories, ya know?
Though... ehehe, let's see—

I already knew that to her, the words didn't simply mean
a "stylish girl from the big city"...

Just like the folks back home, you look at me for who I am, and you believe in me.
It showed me loud and clear that you're rooting for me from the bottom of your heart.

When I was running with an empty mind across that pure white world with only my footsteps echoing,
I felt like I could go anywhere... That's how I fell in love with running.

I'm much happier when folks tell me things straight like this.
Becoming famous just for hype ain't the kind of "city girl" I'm aiming to be.
P-Pardon the intrusion~~!

Isn't there something I can do for Yukino Bijin...?
Before I knew it, my hands had naturally started drafting a training regimen.

Whoaaa...! Thank ya so much!!
I-I've got a lot to learn, but I'll be in your care, yes I will!

Trainer...
Honestly speaking, what do ya think of my current skill...?

Yes! I was born in a tiny village in Morioka.
It's rich in nature, everyone's so kind, and it's just a downright wonderful place!

...Did ya know? Snow absorbs all the surrounding sound,
so when it piles up, everything goes completely, totally silーーent.

That's City-san! Out of all the "city girls" out there,
she's by far the most dazzlingly sparkly Umamusume...!
...Hm? Oh, hey, Yukino.

And so, I started running at the kids' club.
Then everyone was so happy, cheering 'She's so fast, so fast!'...

Ah! Thank goodness, I got the right room!
Sorry to bother ya when you're busy.

Yukino Bijin seemed lost in thought... walking beside me in silence.
Then, after a while, she suddenly spoke up.

Inside the paper bag she handed me was a box of rice crackers in understated packaging.
It read: "Morioka Specialty Treat."

But I only had this vague dream and was just dragging my feet...
That's when... my childhood friend gave me the push I needed!

Looks like you're in the middle of work right now, so please enjoy 'em on your break...
Wait, huh? What's that? "For Yukino Bijin"...?

And then, Gold City delivered a breathtaking performance.
It was genuine, undeniable skill—every bit a match for her radiant beauty...!

It's all thanks to that girl that my... fuzzy dream took on
the clear and definite shape of becoming a "city girl."

Back home, the winters get real harsh, and beautiful snow falls every year.
In the dead of winter, as far as the eye can see, absolutely everything turns stark white.

—And so, I was brought along to Nakayama Racecourse.
The one running in today's race was...

—Mm-hmm, I had no idea training methods like this existed...!
It's super easy to understand and really helpful.

—That was incredible.
The whole venue went wild, like *woooow*...!
